content: Shenlinni Daghazhi Gie
Ingiese ede Mexiha Ersai miendedu kunlade zui jiedui ulie jinjine.
Amin ogiku Shenlinni guijin Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi zuiji fuguku guijinse chii andaghawo.
Kunde lilian wiku yenyinghala guijin gie dakui Huda giewo. Huda zuini widaghane giezhi Kewonne zuitu beyeni yanzighala peizhi ireghadene zuini kunlai ese gonjighawo.
Ingiedene beyeni ulie daghazhi Shenlinni daghasan mai jiere guijinyi yoqiui gholughawo.
Beyeni daghasan kunla beyeni shiqinyi gonxin giene. Shenlinni daghasan kunla Shenlinni shiqinyi gonxin giene.
Beyeni shiqinyi gonxin giese fugune. Shenlinni shiqinyi gonxin giese amin, pinnan irene.
Kun beyeni shiqinyi gonxin giese Hudaghala duitou gholune. Hudai guijinni ulie shunjine, shunjiye dane.
Beyenughunla Hudai bayasugha dane.
Hudai Ruhher tai sudoro souse tashi beyenughun pusho, Shenlinnughun wo. Kunde Mexihani ruhher uwoshi Mexihanughun pusho.
Mexiha tai sudoro bise beye zuini yenyinghala fuguzhoma, ruhher gounii yenyinghala amiturazho.
Ersai fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Hudai Ruhher tai sudoro souse Mexihai fugusan kun dundase aminne olughasan Huda tai sudoro sousan Shenlinne tungo giezhi tai fuguku beyeni aminne olughane.
Gaijiula, ingiese matan beyede zhan chaisan mutun hhei daghazhi gieku biyo uwo.
Ta beyeni daghazhi giese fugune. Shenlinde kouizhi beyeni doghun wiliei fugughase amiturane.
Jien Hudai Ruhher udurusanlashi Hudai kewosi wo.
Ta jienliesanshi hojini ruhher pusho. Pse ulie ayighane. Jienliesanshi kewosi danlaku ruhher wo. Ingiese matan Aba, ada giezhi urune.
Shenlin qinsi matanyi ruhherre hhantu matanshi Hudai kewosi wo giezhi ganzhen beizho.
Kewosi enbese jiachanyi jienliechen enbene. Matanshi Mexihare hhantu jiachanyi jienliechen Hudai kewosi wo. Matan hhere shouku giekude hhantulase famadeye hhantulane.
Jianlaiku Fama
Bi uzhese edeku shouku gieku jianlai matande ireku famaghala bilazhi ulie olune.
Zhayaghasanla jirezhi Hudai kesila xienjizhi khizhekuni panjizho.
Zhayaghasanla yama oronde widawo. Hhela imutui gholukushi goya duranghalane pusho, Huda ingiezhi gieghawo.
Hhela qida olusande hoji danlakuse andadene Hudai kesilani famatu ziyuni jienliekui panjizho.
Zhayaghasanla man hhantu shonholozhi tendun shouizhi eli kusanyi matan mejiene.
Zinie zhayaghasanla pusho, Shenlinshi toushu alima wo giezhi jienliesan matanye zhughedene shonholozhi Hudai kewosi danlaku, pse mai beyei jiuizhi shuikui panjizho.
Onxianghala matanyi jiuiwo. Chujieghekui onxian giese onxian pusho. Chujieghekui kien onxian giene?
Matan chujieghe dakune onxian giese rennai giezhi panjikuni wo.
Niekielien wo, Shenlinye matan zholierekude banman giene. Matan indan matugie onxian giekui ulie mejienema, Shenlin hende nango giezhi qinsi matande xiahua giene.
Kunni zhughei uzhechen Huda Shenlinyi sumulakui mejiene. Shenlin zhao Hudai isighala shentulade oluzhi xiahua giezho.
Hudade oresan kun, jiushi Huda jihuaghalane uruzhi iresan kunlade shiqinla man hhantulazhi gouni gholukui matan mejiene.
Huda eqie mejiesan kunlai kewonne yanzi mutun gholughane giezhi pse eqie jinjiwo. Ingiezhi kewonne olon gaijiu dunda fugie kewon danlaghane giezho.
Hhe eqighan jinjisan kunlai pse uruzhi irewo. Uruzhi iresan kunlai pse gounide sanawo. Gounide sanasan kunlai famani gholughawo.
Hudai Oreku
Ingiese matan enezighan shiqinde yan kieliene? Huda matande banman giese kien fandui giene?
Huda Kewonne sheizhi matande ogiwoma, hhere hhantu pseshikulai man matande ulie oginu?
Kien Huda sunghusan kunlai zha shidane? Hhelai gounide sanasanshi Huda wo.
Kien hhelade zui jinjine? Mexiha Ersa duya ijiezhi aminne oludene ede Hudai borun miende bizhi matande oluzhi xiahua giezho.
Kien Mexiha matande orekui siraghane? Kunnan onu? Khishun onu? Heiku onu? Oliesuku onu? Nanxin onu? Wixien onu? Khudogho onu?
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun,

content.text: Kunla bijienyi alaku ghoni mutun uzhezho."

content: Ingieliuzhe matande oresan Ezhanni tungo giezhi ene soyuji shiqin jiere suibiende injine.
Bi hende xianxin giese bugon fuguku, amituku, qienxien, qienli bareichen, edeku shiqin, jianlaiku shiqin, lilian,
unduni, gunni, psedu zhayaghasanla man Huda mai ezhan Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi matande orekui siragha dane.
